newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Ostrava adds 13 mln marks to Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Czech Ostrava adds 13 mln marks to Eurobond issue.

text.p: The Czech city of Ostrava said on Wednesday that it had agreed to increase its Eurobond issue, originally oversubcribed at 75 million marks ($44.5 million), by another 13 million marks.
A spokeswoman for the city, Jolanda Pilarova, said the city council had agreed to the increase to take advantage of the favourable exchange rate between the crown and the German mark.
"The rate of the mark is the best it has been for the past five years," Pilarova told Reuters by telephone.
She said the additional issue would be arranged by Chase Manhattan Bank Luxembourg SA.
The original issue was launched in December issued at par with yield at 0.225 over the 6-month LIBOR. It was lead-managed by ING Barings.
Further details on the additional issue were not yet available.
The city carries the same Standard & Poor's "A" debt rating as the Czech Republic.
The credit is being raised for early repayment of Ostrava's mark-denominated debt owed to a German firm. -- Jan Lopatka, Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2423-0003
